verdict: Paid leads holding steady at a improving cost; organic visibility needs attention.
narrative: Over the last 28 days, you received 126 leads from Meta at an average cost per lead of $11.73 — and that cost is trending in the right direction, dropping 7.39% week over week even as lead volume held nearly flat (down just 3%). Your top campaign, BWS - Instant Leads - Awareness, carried the majority of paid spend and continues to perform well. On the organic side, Google Business Profile activity fell sharply this past week and is being actively reviewed to restore visibility. The priority heading into next period is ensuring those inbound leads convert to booked appointments, as the current data shows leads arriving but not yet moving through to scheduled visits.

highlights.phrase: leads received via paid ads in the last 28 days
average cost per lead this period, down 7% from the prior week
organic actions on your Google Business Profile this period (calls, directions, website clicks)

watch_item.issue: Leads are arriving but none have converted to booked appointments in the last 28 days, pointing to a gap in the intake process rather than an ads problem.
watch_item.fix: The intake and lead-routing flow is being audited this week to identify and close where contacts are dropping off before they book.
